The backend APIs are working correctly and returning data, but the frontend components are not loading this data into the dropdown options. Check the loadVehicles(), loadCustomers(), loadSuppliers(), and loadAccounts() functions in PartsInventory.jsx to ensure they are properly called and the data is being set in state.
